parsed.english: For viscosity nu > 0 there is a smooth, divergence-free, rapidly decaying initial velocity field u₀ on ℝ³ and a smooth, rapidly decaying force f such that for every candidate pair (v, p) of velocity and pressure, (v, p) is not a smooth, bounded-energy solution of Navier–Stokes with data (u₀, f).
